title: The Unexpected Harbor
author: Vesper Nakamura
blurb: Mirabel Ishikawa, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
